Initial release of dialectical-analysis skill.

- Enables dual-agent dialectical business analysis with a fixed 5-round debate format.
- Produces rigorous business analysis reports through constructive and critical agent discussion.
- Supports both English and Chinese language input and output.
- Allows specification of analysis topic, background, focus questions, and constraints.
